definitions.explanation: A train powered by steam. This term is somewhat dated as steam trains are now rare in Japan.

examples.japanese: {昔|むかし}は{汽車|きしゃ}で{旅行|りょこう}した。
examples.english: In the old days, people traveled by steam train.

examples.japanese: {汽車|きしゃ}の{煙|けむり}が{見|み}える。
examples.english: I can see the smoke from the steam train.

examples.japanese: {汽車|きしゃ}に{乗|の}ったことがありますか。
examples.english: Have you ever ridden a steam train?

examples.japanese: {汽車|きしゃ}の{音|おと}が{聞|き}こえる。
examples.english: I can hear the sound of the steam train.

examples.japanese: {汽車|きしゃ}で{旅|たび}をしたい。
examples.english: I want to travel by steam train.

notes: While {電車|でんしゃ} (densha) refers to electric trains commonly used today, {汽車|きしゃ} specifically refers to steam-powered trains. In some rural areas, people may still use {汽車|きしゃ} colloquially to mean any train.
